5371.title: ACP worker shutdown leaves agent processes running
5371.rootCauseOneLine: ACP workers omit signal cleanup hooks and normal close only stops registered sessions, leaving discovery agents outside lifecycle ownership.
5371.proposedFix: Track all ACP connections, prevent starts during shutdown, and share awaited cleanup across EOF, SIGTERM and SIGINT.
5371.caveats: Reproduced with the real worker and a deterministic Node ACP agent on Linux, not proprietary cursor-agent on macOS. Eight unrelated Claude protocol contract failures also reproduce on unchanged main.
